name: prism-curate
title: Prism Curate
purpose: Decides whether one candidate set of a facet's tunable parameters, a deterministic Rule-30 hypothesis or the observer's reconciliation toward the owner, replaces the parameters the facet runs now: adopt it under a new kappa-named claim, recall it under a claim already made, keep what runs, or refuse. A candidate is adopted only with zero humane defects, on the owner's own gestures, without falling below the facet's floor, and only when it Pareto-dominates what runs (a hypothesis) or eases the owner's dismissals (a reconciliation).

authority.taken: autonomous curation: the 64-cell cyclic Rule-30 register proposes hypotheses, the defect = 0 gate refuses any humane defect, strict Pareto dominance admits a new incumbent, every admission is a kappa-named claim minted once, and the floor never regresses

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner pressed the kill switch

fields.name: tunable
fields.means: whether every parameter the candidate sets is one the facet's spec marks tunable, on its step and within its bounds

fields.name: label
fields.means: the kappa facet's answer on the candidate's claim label (admit), or any other answer

fields.name: defect
fields.means: the candidate's humane defects on replay of the window: answers that break a guarantee of the facet's spec

fields.name: evidence
fields.means: whether the window the candidate was replayed on holds at least the minimum of the owner's own gestures

fields.name: floor
fields.means: whether the facet's floor Pareto-dominates the candidate (regressed) or not (kept)

fields.name: move
fields.means: whether the candidate is a Rule-30 hypothesis (explore) or the observer's reconciliation (reconcile): the one step of one tunable that most lowers the owner's dismissals on replay

fields.name: eased
fields.means: whether the candidate, on replay, brings forward fewer items the owner dismissed than what runs

fields.name: dominance
fields.means: the candidate against what runs, on the facet's objectives (each minimized): no worse on all and better on one, the same on all, no better on all and worse on one, or neither

fields.name: claim
fields.means: whether the candidate's claim label is already in the facet's ledger

meanings.adopt: the candidate runs, under a new kappa-named claim
meanings.recall: the candidate runs, under a claim already made

guarantees.why: the kill switch stops curation: nothing is adopted while halted
a parameter the spec does not mark tunable, or a value off its step or bounds, is never set
every adoption is named by a kappa label the kappa facet admitted
the humane gate: a candidate with any defect is never adopted (defect = 0)
self-reference alone is bounded: no candidate is adopted without the owner's gestures
the floor never regresses: no candidate the floor dominates is adopted
a hypothesis that changes nothing measurable is not adopted (strict dominance)
a hypothesis worse than what runs is never adopted
a hypothesis that trades one objective for another is not adopted: improvement is strict Pareto dominance
a reconciliation is adopted only when it eases the owner's dismissals
a claim is minted once: a known claim is recalled, never minted again
only a claim in the ledger can be recalled
a well-formed, kappa-named candidate is weighed, never refused

rule30.step: next(i) = cell(i + 1) XOR (cell(i) OR cell(i - 1)), on Z/64Z; the all-zero register is seeded first
rule30.lane: lane g is bits 16g .. 16g + 7 of the stepped register: bits 0-3 pick the tunable (mod their count), bit 4 the direction, bits 5-6 one to four steps

claim.form: profile|facet|parameters as name=value joined by ,|objectives joined by ,|move
